reason: 包含识别自身偏见和运用减少偏见策略的训练曾降低特定种族隐性偏见，支持重新教育的一部分作用。综合研究指出持久效果和发表偏差仍有疑问，且识别操纵本身未必提高真实性判断，不能据此确认公共意见整体贴近环境或庞大的刻板化机制已被消解。
quote: The effect of naming, the effect, that is, of saying that the labor groups C and M, but not X, are underpaid, instead of saying that Labor is Exploited, is incisive. Perceptions recover their identity, and the emotion they arouse is specific, since it is no longer reinforced by large and accidental connections with everything from Christmas to Moscow. The disentangled idea with a name of its own, and an emotion that has been scrutinized, is ever so much more open to correction by new data in the problem. It had been imbedded in the whole personality, had affiliations of some sort with the whole ego: a challenge would reverberate through the whole soul. After it has been thoroughly criticized, the idea is no longer _me_ but _that_. It is objectified, it is at arm's length. Its fate is not bound up with my fate, but with the fate of the outer world upon which I am acting. 5 Re-education of this kind will help to bring our public opinions into grip with the environment. That is the way the enormous censoring, stereotyping, and dramatizing apparatus can be liquidated.
claim: 这种重新教育将帮助公共意见接近实际环境，并可消解审查、刻板印象与戏剧化的庞大机制。

reason: 政府统计史明确记载，出版后继续围绕具体实践问题设立统计单位，统计还被制度化用于宏观政策和公共资源分配。信息搜集成为决策的常规需要并再供社会科学使用，符合原句关于直接动因与后续用途的主要判断。
quote: Therefore, though here, as in most other matters, "education" is the supreme remedy, the value of this education will depend upon the evolution of knowledge. And our knowledge of human institutions is still extraordinarily meager and impressionistic. The gathering of social knowledge is, on the whole, still haphazard; not, as it will have to become, the normal accompaniment of action. And yet the collection of information will not be made, one may be sure, for the sake of its ultimate use. It will be made because modern decision requires it to be made.
claim: 社会知识搜集将成为行动的常规配套，搜集的直接动因将是现代决策需要，而非其最终教育用途。

claim: 在理性发展得足够细致具体以前，现实政治斗争仍将需要理性无法提供或控制的机智、力量和未经证明的信念。
